StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Sekiro:_Shadows_Die_Twice
Fandom (sekiro.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://sekiro.fandom.com/wiki/Sekiro:_Shadows_Die_Twice
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The Steam app is listed in the store list as "Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice - GOTY Edition" (814380); its schema gives no game name. StrategyWiki has a page (no completion stage in its page data) with no subpages at all; Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written. sekiro.fandom.com answers the API, but its page has only 7 links; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 23 of 34 Steam achievements are hidden. They were split by schema position: the 9 listed among the completion goals at the top of the schema went to "Late Game and Mastery", and the 14 listed after the early-game ones (all named after characters or creatures) went to the main story. That split is an inference from list order and unlock rates, not from descriptions.
